hypothesis_origin.discovery_pool: targeted100 labels on seed 10..29, with 60 additional label-free class/seed paths in the score reference
hypothesis_origin.narrow_descriptive_clue: Three global_blur clear-bad paths were high under the unchanged full PTCV score; structural clear-bad paths were inverted.
hypothesis_origin.allowed_new_hypothesis: The unchanged full PTCV score is positively associated with global_blur clear-bad endpoints.
hypothesis_origin.forbidden_claim: This protocol does not reopen the failed generic-artifact endpoint and cannot validate structural, topology, or misalignment detection.

model_scope.sampler_states: official CFG=4 ancestral DDPM-250 trajectory states

validation_population.primary_endpoint: all 9 adjudicated clear_bad endpoints, each pre-existing majority_flags contains global_blur, versus all 304 clean_good endpoints
validation_population.independence_boundary: Seeds and locked files are disjoint from PTCV discovery and labels predate PTCV, but researchers previously inspected this historical pool; this is stronger than same-pool discovery and weaker than a newly sampled prospective confirmation.

unchanged_ptcv_object.identity: Jacobian_x m_t^c=(alpha_t/sigma_t^2) Cov(X_0|X_t=x,c), hence symmetric PSD
unchanged_ptcv_object.basis_kind: normalized 4x4 Hadamard channel modes tensor four orthonormal 2-D DCT modes
unchanged_ptcv_object.class_standardization: Within each expansion class, use all 120 label-free paths: S_i=(D_i-mean_c)/(sample_sd_c+1e-12).

fixed_simple_controls.single_path_temporal_change: mean frozen checkpoint CFG pred_xstart relative changes, class-standardized; higher is worse
fixed_simple_controls.raw_conditional_cfg_gap: mean raw-conditional versus CFG pred_xstart relative gap, class-standardized; higher is worse

label_free_numerical_gates_before_any_jo.failure_action: STOP as numerically unresolved before visual labels are opened.

primary: tie-aware ROC AUC for the unchanged full S on 9 global-blur clear_bad versus 304 clean_good
exact one-sided class-stratified rank-sum randomization p-value computed by dynamic programming
each clear_bad within-class percentile and count above class median
robustness: leave-one-positive-class-out AUC without changing the score formula
class-specific AUC for all three classes
leave-one-checkpoint-out AUC, reported without selecting a replacement score
descriptive_only: comparison or correlation with prior handcrafted blur metric B

advance_narrow_blur_signal_only_if: every label-free numerical gate passes before labels are opened
primary higher-direction AUC is at least 0.70
exact higher-direction class-stratified p-value is at most 0.05
at least 6 of 9 clear_bad paths are above their class-specific median
the 95% class-stratified bootstrap AUC lower bound exceeds 0.50
primary AUC is not below any fixed simple control AUC
every leave-one-positive-class-out AUC is at least 0.55
at least two positive-containing classes have class-specific AUC strictly above 0.5
decision_rule.strong_historical_validation: All advance gates plus AUC>=0.80, exact p<=0.01, at least 8/9 bad above class median, bootstrap lower bound>0.55, every class-LOO AUC>=0.60, and primary AUC exceeds every control by >=0.03.
decision_rule.checkpoint_leave_out_role: Mechanistic robustness only; it cannot replace the unchanged full primary score and is not an advance gate for the explicitly early/mid blur hypothesis.
decision_rule.failure_action: STOP the PTCV blur-specific hypothesis. Do not rescue it by sign, component, checkpoint, class, basis, radius, endpoint, or combination search on expansion.
decision_rule.success_boundary: At most authorize a newly sampled, fully prospective blur confirmation. No rejection, guidance, rollback, or selective resampling is authorized by this historical validation.
